places.Anthem Waters valley, gold (ch11): wide shallow valley of pale sand between tall brass-coloured kelp trunks, warm gold light in shafts, a ridge far off, healthy forest (bg c11_valley_gold). Entirely underwater.
places.Anthem Waters valley under the brown spo: same valley with a thick curtain of brown refinery spoil falling in sheets across it (bg c11_valley_brown).
places.Anthem Waters valley, silent (ch11): same valley after the order: dull grey-gold light, broken hull plates, torn trawl nets and crushed grey wreckage on the sand, kelp standing still (bg c11_valley_silent).
places.Anthem Waters valley, dusk (ch11): deep blue-violet water, a last gold at the top, wreckage, faint yellow-green lights at the far edge (bg c11_valley_dusk).
places.Anthem Waters valley, night (ch11): almost black blue water, pale ghostly kelp, dim wreckage (bg c11_valley_night).
places.Anthem Waters valley, morning (ch11): cold pale silver-blue water with thin gold dawn glow, wreckage, still kelp (bg c11_valley_morning).
